auth_details: Requires X-Api-Key header (api.data.gov key). DEMO_KEY allowed for limited exploration.
free_tier_limits: Personal keys: 1,000 requests/hour; DEMO_KEY: 30 requests/IP/hour and 50 requests/IP/day.
rate_limits: Personal key: 1,000 requests/hour; DEMO_KEY: 30 requests/IP/hour and 50 requests/IP/day.
description: data.gov Catalog API v4 is the current GSA API for searching open-data catalog metadata across federal, state, local, and tribal sources. The older CKAN API at catalog.data.gov remains available as a read-only legacy interface; new integrations should use v4 with an api.data.gov key.
resolution_notes: Awaiting live verification of official sources for each disputed field.
